audit.whatIsWrong: The level chart itself is correct and both layers already agree with the packet (Sion, Sion, Ryze, Sion, Skill, Ryze, Sion), but the page called this a 'Favoured matchup — difficulty 4/10' with diff FAVOURED, against a 45.16% win rate over 434 games and its own chart giving Sion four of seven rows.
audit.why: Ryze has two real windows (level 3 and the first mana item) and loses the rest; that is a lane you play carefully, not a favoured one.
audit.corrected: diff -> TRICKY, tone -> the repo's tricky orange, diffRating -> 6.5/10, carryRating -> 6/10, and both difficulty lines rewritten. tldr/report[0].t no longer claim the lane 'can't ever kill you'.

audit.why: Level 3 (full Flux loop vs a dashless Sion), the first mana item (near-spammable root chain that beats Soul Furnace's regeneration), and Sion's two-item tank spike are the real breakpoints and spikes[0..3] carry them.

audit.whatIsWrong: Three problems. (a) wants.foe[1] said Sion can 'walk through your W root with CC-immunity' — Soul Furnace is a shield with a 3-second reactivation for magic damage; nothing in his kit grants CC immunity. (b) spikes[0] said Roar of the Slayer 'outranges your entire kit' — it is 800 range and Overload is 1000. (c) Decimating Smash's stun was written as unconditional; Riot's text conditions the knockup and stun on charging long enough.
audit.why: Each one changes what a player does: the CC-immunity line tells them their root is worthless, the range line tells them to stop poking back with Q, and the charge line hides the fact that leaving the cone early turns the stun into a plain hit.
audit.corrected: wants.foe[1], spikes[0].text, dosFull[0].d and report[5].t rewritten with Riot's actual text plus the 800/1000 ranges and the 10s rank-1 Q cooldown.

audit.whatIsWrong: All three flagged interactions were absent: Glory in Death healing him through chip damage, his resistance/HP-stacking bypass, and Unstoppable Onslaught cutting the retreat of a dashless Ryze.
audit.why: Ryze has no dash, so a ramping R along a side-lane corridor is a death sentence Flash exists to answer; and Grievous Wounds timing decides whether his zombie form finishes you after you 'killed' him.
audit.corrected: spikes[3].text now states the terrain/retreat problem; report[8].t adds the Grievous Wounds timing.
